description: This file defines the IOQueue class, which is a component that manages queued work items and executes them, utilizing thread pool and synchronization primitives. It is part of Orleans.Networking.Shared, implementing a pipe scheduling and thread pool work item interface.

classes.name: IOQueue
classes.description: A class that manages a queue of work items, scheduling and executing them asynchronously, used internally for networking I/O operations in Orleans.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Enqueues a new work item and schedules its execution if not already scheduled.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Processes the queued work items, executing their callbacks in a loop until no more work remains.
